also: put it in the fridge to chill

terms.gloss: refrigerate or chill by putting in the fridge
terms.comment: Distinguish position in frīgidāriō from movement in arcam.

phrases.english: Put the milk back in the fridge.

phrases.latin: Būtȳrum ē frīgidāriō prōme, ut mollēscat.
phrases.english: Take the butter out of the fridge so it gets soft.

phrases.latin: Placentam in frīgidārium pōne, ut concrēscat.
phrases.english: Chill the cake in the fridge so that it sets.

sources: Lewis & Short: promo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 124.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. refrigerator.
